fact: Liberia's Environmental Protection Agency, in a notice issued 6 April 2026, seeks a consultant to design and develop a cloud-based Automated Decision Management System using AI and ML to forecast floods, droughts and extreme weather and generate alerts, with an MVP in pilot counties before a rollout to all 15 counties.
system: Automated Decision Management System (ADMS), Liberia Climate Information System Project

fact: Otuba Paul of PIH Liberia says AI-powered chest X-ray interpretation (qXR v3.2) was deployed to support TB screening at James Jenkins Dossen Hospital in Maryland County from March 2023 to January 2025, with the National Leprosy and Tuberculosis Control Program and the county health team, and helped identify Xpert-negative and asymptomatic patients.

The Executive Mansion says four AI X-ray machines for TB screening, donated with Global Fund support, were dedicated and distributed to four hospitals in Montserrado and Margibi, producing TB reports in under 15 seconds.
system: AI X-ray machines for TB screening
